body: ADVISOR RULING (19:40 MST), TASK-2707 PR1 receipt question: R-a APPROVED. PR1 adds ContainmentReceipt, pinned to the actual worker (namespace identity, host-side uid_map 1:1, policy SHA). containment_applied() is true for Codex ONLY with a receipt; posture=aida with no receipt refuses the launch. Claude keeps today's behaviour as an explicitly named ClaudeNative arm until PR3 replaces it with a receipt (C12/M1). Add a ratchet test: no Codex arm returns applied without a receipt. R-b rejected: it changes Claude lanes' mailbox and AIDA_CONTAINED behaviour before PR3.
subject: RULING: R-a
